scripts.dev: pnpm build:data && pnpm --filter @labkit/web build && pnpm --parallel --filter @labkit/web --filter @labkit/worker dev
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:data && pnpm --filter @labkit/web exec vite build --mode development && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:data && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/parsers && tsc -p apps/worker && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p scripts
scripts.test:private:e2e: pnpm build:data && pnpm --filter @labkit/web exec vite build --mode development && LABKIT_PRIVATE=1 playwright test e2e/private.spec.ts; status=$?; rm -rf test-results playwright-report; exit $status
